product.name: 2305 Series Brass, MOD 0.8, Servo Gear (25 Tooth Spline, 12 Tooth)

warnings: Outer diameter is calculated from the gear specs: MOD 0.8 with 12 teeth gives a pitch diameter of 9.6 mm and a tip diameter of 9.6 + 2×0.8 = 11.2 mm. The listed center distances confirm the module: 24 mm with the 48-tooth gear and 48 mm with the 108-tooth gear. Face width (about 8 mm) is a visual estimate from the pencil scale photo and is not stated. The bore (about 5.8 mm) is an assumed nominal size for a 25-tooth servo spline; its diameter is not given in the text. The recess on one face is visible but its diameter and depth are not stated, so it is not listed as a hole. The gear axis is along z, centered at the origin.
Face width (8 mm) and bore diameter (5.8 mm) are estimates; no dimensions were provided.
The internal 25-tooth spline is omitted; the bore is a plain round hole.
The shallow recess on one face is omitted because its diameter and depth are unknown.
Tooth root is a straight-sided polygonal approximation with no root fillet, and the involute flank is approximated with 8 segments.
